mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event_archive (id, tenant_id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, application_id, action, actor_id, payload_json, occurred_at, archived_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{applicationId}, #{action}, #{actorId}, #{payloadJson}, #{occurredAt}, #{archivedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_retention_run (id, tenant_id, cutoff_at, archived_count, triggered_by, executed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{cutoffAt}, #{archivedCount}, #{triggeredBy}, #{executedAt})
